files.auth/retention.py:
import datetime

from .db import connect

RETENTION_DAYS = 90


def purge_old_sessions() -> int:
    """Delete sessions older than the retention window. Runs hourly."""
    cutoff = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc) - datetime.timedelta(days=RETENTION_DAYS)
    with connect() as conn:
        cur = conn.execute("DELETE FROM sessions WHERE last_seen > %s", (cutoff,))
        return cur.rowcount

defects.what: last_seen > cutoff deletes every ACTIVE session (seen in the last 90 days) and keeps the stale ones
